args.request: Adversarial teardown and improvement of the carmodels natural-language library filter (tools/library_filter.py, tools/serve_library.py, dealership.html semantic box, recovered.html Interpret search). Measured problems: valid game/variant requests were mostly withheld (9/20, 12/22, 15/25 applied live); an instruction-like query and an other-catalog query were wrongly applied; on the documented stock interpreter the feature returned a generic "unavailable" for every request with no diagnostic; UI discarded server error messages and showed raw abort text. Required: fix these while preserving the documented fail-closed policy (review/error never changes filters, no incorrect filter applied, unsupported attributes never inferred, credentials server-side, no exception text exposed), add no new dependency, add regression tests that run in tools/check.sh, and document the change and its measured evidence in research/.
